clue.text: Cunningly escaped from misguided casting director

indicators.note: casting here means throwing off or shedding, so a letter is discarded from the word before it

parts.note: someone misguided has been deluded
D is a standard abbreviation for director

explanation.surface: A wily escape from a casting director who has got things badly wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Casting director' looks like one job title, but the words split: casting means dropping, and the director is just the letter D shed from DELUDED to leave ELUDED.
explanation.definitionFit: To elude someone is to evade them by cunning or agility, so the past tense means slipped away from them artfully.

clue.text: Remove material from last bit of meal for one

indicators.note: the last bit of a word is its final letter, so only the closing letter is kept

parts.note: the final letter of meal
each means for one, as in prices of a pound each

explanation.surface: Clearing away the leftover end of a meal, one plate at a time.
explanation.walkthrough: Leaching is what water does to soil, washing out soluble minerals.
explanation.definitionFit: To leach a substance is to drain soluble matter out of it by percolating liquid, so it removes material from it.

clue.text: Homer often said that Odyssey short of content about ring

parts.note: D'oh! is the catchphrase of Homer Simpson

indicators.note: about can mean turned round, so the kept letters are read the other way
a word short of its content has lost everything inside, leaving only its outside letters

parts.note: the first and last letters of Odyssey

explanation.surface: A classicist observes that Homer kept saying something about a ring in his epic.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface points to Homer the Greek poet of the Odyssey, but the Homer meant is Homer Simpson, whose exasperated D'oh! starts the answer; OY turned about gives YO.
explanation.definitionFit: The dohyo is the raised circular ring of clay in which sumo wrestlers fight.

clue.text: Take pleasure in 500+8/50

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500

indicators.note: the slash cuts through the number before it, so that number is split open to take the one after

parts.note: the number written out as a word
L is the Roman numeral for 50

explanation.surface: Someone takes pleasure in a bit of arithmetic written as a string of numbers and symbols.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue looks like a sum to compute, but the plus sign just joins D to what follows, and the slash marks where L is wedged inside EIGHT, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To delight is to feel great joy, so it serves as a verb for taking pleasure.

clue.text: Something half-heartedly organised for Indonesian

indicators.note: with half the heart gone, one of the two middle letters of the word is dropped

parts.note: summat is the northern English dialect form of something
to run a business is to organise it

explanation.surface: Some event was put together without much enthusiasm for a person from Indonesia.
explanation.walkthrough: SUMMAT is northern English dialect for something; its heart is the double M, and losing half of it leaves SUMAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Sumatra is a large island of Indonesia, so a Sumatran is an Indonesian from there.

clue.text: Mishandle gang overwhelmed by drink

indicators.note: a thing overwhelmed by another is engulfed within it, so one word sits inside the other

parts.note: to sup is to drink
a crew is a gang of workers or friends

explanation.surface: A gang the worse for drink makes a mess of things.
explanation.definitionFit: To screw up a task is an informal idiom for botching it, which is to mishandle it.

clue.text: They suffer damage years after contract's termination

parts.note: to mar is to damage

indicators.note: the termination of a word is its end, so only its closing letter is taken

parts.note: the final letter of contract
YRS is the standard abbreviation for years

explanation.surface: People pay the price for years once a contract comes to an end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' puts the years at the end, behind MAR and the T.
explanation.definitionFit: Martyrs are people who endure suffering or death for their beliefs, so they are ones who suffer.

clue.text: Tease Trump about Californian city flipping in important battle site

indicators.note: flipping something turns it over, so the whole string is read backwards
about means surrounding, so the pair of words goes round the place name

parts.note: to rag someone is to tease them
in British slang to trump is to break wind
LA is Los Angeles

explanation.surface: A jibe at Donald Trump going berserk in a Californian city.
explanation.walkthrough: Trump is not the politician: in British slang to trump is to break wind. The insertion happens first, and only then is the whole string flipped.
explanation.definitionFit: Cape Trafalgar off southern Spain was where Nelson defeated the French and Spanish fleets in 1805.

clue.text: Chaps repeatedly separating atomic isotopes of hydrogen, for a change

indicators.note: things separating others are placed between them, splitting the group apart

parts.note: A is an abbreviation for atomic, as in A-bomb
chaps are men
D is the symbol for deuterium, the first heavy isotope of hydrogen
the chaps come a second time
T is the symbol for tritium, the second heavy isotope of hydrogen

explanation.surface: A physics instruction: put people between hydrogen isotopes to alter something.
explanation.walkthrough: The heavy hydrogen isotopes deuterium and tritium have their own symbols, D and T; with A they make ADT, and MEN goes into each of the two gaps.
explanation.definitionFit: An amendment is an alteration, especially to a text or law, so it is a change.

clue.text: Young knight and classical composer having role reversal

parts.note: Johann Sebastian Bach

indicators.note: the clue literally asks for the preceding word to be turned the other way round

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A young knight and a great composer swap parts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Role reversal' reads as a phrase about swapping parts, but it means the word ROLE written backwards, ELOR.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically a bachelor was a young knight serving under another's banner, a sense surviving in the title knight bachelor.

clue.text: American in historic city close to Dortmund wandered aimlessly

indicators.note: in places one thing inside the other

parts.note: Rome, the ancient capital
A is an abbreviation for American

indicators.note: the close of a word is its end, so only its last letter is used

parts.note: the final letter of Dortmund

explanation.surface: An American tourist drifts about a historic German city near Dortmund.
explanation.definitionFit: To roam is to travel without purpose or set route, so roamed means wandered aimlessly.

clue.text: Husband in rut? Wife always suggests a quick route across the pond

definitions.text: a quick route across the pond

indicators.note: in places one thing inside the other

parts.note: a trough is a long narrow hollow, like a rut
H is the abbreviation for husband
W is the abbreviation for wife
ay, or aye, is an old word for always

explanation.surface: A wife says her husband stuck in a rut always wants the fast road.
explanation.walkthrough: Across the pond means in America; ay meaning ever is an archaic and poetic form.
explanation.definitionFit: A throughway, or thruway, is the American word for an expressway, a fast highway.

clue.text: Backing Canadians to embrace opera

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the letters are read right to left
to embrace is to hold within, so the letters sit inside the word

parts.note: the letters in the middle of Canadians

explanation.surface: Canadian supporters getting behind an opera production.
explanation.definitionFit: Aida is Verdi's opera about an Ethiopian princess enslaved in Egypt.

clue.text: Cope badly tackling army manual

indicators.note: tackling means wrapping around and grappling, so one word holds the other
something done badly is botched and disordered, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written
a host is an army, as in the heavenly host

explanation.surface: Struggling to get to grips with a military handbook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Army manual' looks like one item, a soldier's handbook, but army supplies HOST and manual stands alone: an organ's echo stop can be a whole keyboard, or manual.
explanation.definitionFit: An echo stop is an organ stop or keyboard controlling quiet pipes that sound distant; an organ keyboard played by hand is called a manual.

clue.text: Approval of evacuation

definitions.meaning: first meaning: official permission, as for a flight or security access
second meaning: the emptying or removal of a place's contents

explanation.surface: Permission is granted to empty a building.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both authorisation to proceed and the act of clearing something out, such as a slum clearance.

clue.text: Placated after hole made less clear

parts.note: O looks like a hole
placated means calmed, pacified

explanation.surface: Someone was calmed down after a puncture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' sets the placated word behind the hole.
explanation.definitionFit: To opacify is to make opaque, so something opacified has been rendered less transparent.

clue.text: SEAL gets in training

indicators.note: training puts things through drills and reshapes them, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters as written

explanation.surface: A recruit gets into Navy SEAL training.
explanation.walkthrough: Capitals suggest the US Navy SEALs special forces, but the word just means a seal for stamping.
explanation.definitionFit: A signet is a small seal, often set in a ring, used to stamp wax on documents.

clue.text: Plot to get gold bullion, primarily, and smear with paint?

parts.note: a garden plot is a flower bed
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so only the opening letter is taken

parts.note: the opening letter of bullion

explanation.surface: A heist plan to steal gold, and then a bit of vandalism with paint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plot' looks like a scheme to rob, but it is a garden bed.
explanation.definitionFit: To bedaub is to smear or daub something messily, paint being a typical substance, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Polish potato dish mostly found in New York City

indicators.note: mostly means not all of it, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: to buff is to polish
aloo is the Hindi word for potato, as in aloo gobi

explanation.surface: A Polish potato dish turns up in a New York restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital P makes Polish the nationality, but it is the verb meaning shine.
explanation.definitionFit: Buffalo is a city in New York State, on Lake Erie near Niagara Falls.

clue.text: What to pay actors to emasculate

parts.note: the actors in a production are its cast
the rate is what one pays

explanation.surface: A question about actors' pay that ends brutally.
explanation.walkthrough: Read together, 'what to pay actors' describes a cast rate, the fee for the players.
explanation.definitionFit: To castrate is to remove the testicles, and figuratively to weaken, so it means to emasculate.

clue.text: Women in Asian country good for gossip

indicators.note: in places one thing inside the other

parts.note: the country in East Asia
W is the abbreviation for women
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: Women in an Asian country are good at having a natter.
explanation.definitionFit: A chinwag is informal British slang for a chat or a gossip.

clue.text: Balls ups stop, with care, after nurse intervenes at last

indicators.note: at last points to the end of each word, so the closing letters are the ones kept

parts.words: ups stop, with care, after nurse intervenes
parts.note: the final letter of each of the seven words

explanation.surface: A nurse finally steps in to stop the blunders, carefully.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Balls ups' reads as one word, blunders, but the hyphen is missing: Balls is the definition and the end letters start with ups.
explanation.definitionFit: Spheres are round solid shapes, so they are balls.

clue.text: Last third of 7up with bit of ice in Hindu ritual

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means read from bottom to top, so it runs backwards
only the closing third of the word survives; the first two thirds are dropped

parts.note: the answer at 7-down

indicators.note: a bit of a word is just one letter of it, here its first

parts.note: the opening letter of ice

explanation.surface: A recipe: the end of a can of 7up poured over a bit of ice.
explanation.walkthrough: 7up looks like the soft drink, but it means the 7-down answer read upwards, RAGLAFART, whose last third is ART. Arti, or aarti, is a Hindu worship ritual in which lamps are waved before a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Arti is a Hindu devotional ceremony offering light from oil lamps to deities, so it is a Hindu ritual.

clue.text: Argue about Liberal left probing Knock airport's information pack

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word goes round the party letter

parts.note: to fight is to argue
L is the abbreviation for Liberal

indicators.note: something probing pokes inside, so the side letter goes into the next word

parts.note: to pan is to criticise harshly
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A quarrel about a Liberal leftie investigating Ireland's Knock airport.
explanation.walkthrough: Knock is an Irish town with an airport, but here knock means criticise, giving PAN, into which the L for left goes.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight plan is the document of route, timing and fuel details filed with air traffic control before a flight.

clue.text: Carol shows situation initially in hand

indicators.note: in places one thing inside the other

parts.note: the palm is the inside of the hand

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so only the first letter is taken

parts.note: the opening letter of situation

explanation.surface: Carol shows the situation is under control from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: Carol looks like a woman's name, but it is a song of praise.
explanation.definitionFit: A psalm is a sacred song of praise and a carol a joyful hymn, so the two are near synonyms.

clue.text: Record shock news for parish priest

indicators.note: for means in place of, so one pair of letters is swapped out for another

parts.note: to appal is to shock
N is short for new, so two of them are news
PP is the abbreviation for parish priest

explanation.surface: A priest receives shocking news about his parish.
explanation.walkthrough: PP in APPAL is replaced by NN; parish priest as PP is a Catholic title.
explanation.definitionFit: An annal is a record of a single year's events, the singular of annals, so it is a record.

clue.text: Those who oppose the right of motoring organisation to check books provided

indicators.note: to check something is to hold it back or contain it, so one goes round the rest

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, Britain's motoring organisation
NT is the New Testament
if means provided that

explanation.surface: Opponents of the right of a motoring body to inspect its books.
explanation.walkthrough: The AA is Britain's Automobile Association, a breakdown service; the right means the political right, not an entitlement.
explanation.definitionFit: Antifa is the loose movement of anti-fascist activists who confront the far right.

clue.text: Pervert isn't in heavy make-up?

parts.note: to warp something is to pervert or distort it
ain't is a colloquial form of isn't

explanation.surface: A pervert does not wear heavy make-up, or so it asks.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful definition: war paint is also slang for heavy cosmetics.
explanation.definitionFit: War paint is the face paint warriors wore and, jokingly, a lavish layer of cosmetics.

clue.text: Principal spread out without thought

parts.note: a school principal is its head
something spread out is extended, long

explanation.surface: A school principal spread-eagled with an empty mind.
explanation.definitionFit: Rushing headlong means acting rashly and impetuously, with no pause for reflection.

clue.text: Soprano with plenty of taste

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for soprano
ample means plenty

explanation.surface: A singer with refined taste.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plenty of taste' reads as praise for the singer, but taste is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To sample food is to try a little of it, which is to taste it.
